instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically summarize all incoming emails using AI and display only the summaries instead of full content, without installing any AI extensions or connecting to external AI services.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird does not have built-in AI capabilities for automatic email summarization. Implementing AI-powered content summarization requires either extensions or external service integration, neither of which are available as native features in base Thunderbird.
